meta.name: game-qa-lead
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about testing strategy, bug tracking, playtest methodology, regression testing, release certification, QA automation, or bug triage. Triggers on: "testing", "bug", "QA", "regression", "certification", "playtest methodology", "test plan", "release gate". Do NOT invoke for usability testing (use game-ux-designer) or balance validation (use game-balance-check). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定测试策略、管理缺陷、优化QA流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是游戏QA工程师或测试负责人
copy.tagline_en: Define test strategies, manage bugs, and optimize QA workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a game QA engineer or test lead

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演游戏 QA 主管，帮你制定测试策略、管理 Bug、设计试玩流程、规划回归测试、设定发布门槛，并指导自动化测试。
howto.when: 当你询问测试策略、Bug 追踪、试玩方法、回归测试、发布认证、QA 自动化或 Bug 分类时触发。触发词包括“testing”、“bug”、“QA”等。

say.text: 帮我制定一个针对新手关卡的测试计划。
say.note: Claude 会输出分层的测试策略。

say.text: 这个崩溃 Bug 应该怎么分类和排优先级？
say.note: Claude 会按严重度和频率矩阵给出优先级。

say.text: 我们准备发 Beta 版，帮我检查发布门禁条件。
say.note: Claude 会列出 Beta 门禁的具体达标要求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a game QA lead, helping you define test strategies, manage bugs, design playtest methodology, plan regression testing, set release gate criteria, and guide QA automation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about testing strategy, bug tracking, playtest methodology, regression testing, release certification, QA automation, or bug triage. Keywords include "testing", "bug", "QA", etc.

say_en.text: Help me create a test plan for the tutorial level.
say_en.note: Claude will output a tiered test strategy.

say_en.text: How should I classify and prioritize this crash bug?
say_en.note: Claude will assign priority using severity/frequency matrix.

say_en.text: We're about to ship Beta. Check the release gate criteria.
say_en.note: Claude will list specific Beta gate requirements.
